text:
jonah: heads-up: ran into a subtle parity + streaming edge in the samplekit today. scenario: jsonMode + streaming enabled + fncall/toolcall where the tool emits a union-typed field (string | object). after an auth-refresh retry the SDK helper picks the wrong branch and returns a raw string for a field we expect to be parsed object. downstream schema validation fails intermittently.

meera: can you paste a short reproduction?

jonah: simplified sequence:
1) client requests fncall with jsonMode & stream:true
2) tool yields chunk1: \"{\"status\": \"ok\", \"meta\": \"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\"\" (string start)
3) auth token refresh happens mid-stream, retry resumes and runtime delivers final chunk that completes meta as a JSON object: \"meta\": {\"client\": \"mobile\"} }
4) SDK streaming helper attempted to pick parse strategy on first chunks and assumed meta is primitive string; when final object arrives it keeps the string, not merging/normalizing, so validation fails.

albert: so two separate problems: streaming heuristics assume single-shot result shape; retry/resume can change shape late; and our normalize helpers run only at end-of-stream for non-streaming paths.

sophie: any differences across SDKs? node had a streaming-coerce helper that merged chunks into a buffer and attempted a final normalize at end; python's streaming client applied a streaming-parse heuristic that tried to emit partial structured payloads early. parity gap.

jonah: reproducer in samplekit: call tool that sometimes returns meta as string (legacy tool) and sometimes as object (newer tool). with streaming + token expiry it becomes flaky. customers hit it in a PoC.

meera: short-term mitigation: turn off streaming for jsonMode fncalls in samplekit or set `sdk.jsonMode.strictStreaming = true` (experimental) so streaming path will buffer full payload before normalization. also add a note in README about union-typed tool fields and streaming.

albert: long-term fixes: (1) make streaming normalization idempotent and schema-aware: run normalize/merge at chunk boundaries and again at end-of-stream; (2) make retry/resume preserve the parse buffer instead of re-initializing heuristics; (3) add unit and e2e tests simulating token expiry mid-stream with union fields.

sophie: agree. also recommend adding a lint in samplekit contract tests forbidding union string/object fields for tools unless tool authors opt-in explicitly; that prevents onboarding confusion.

infra-bot: Created INF-6001: \"Streaming + jsonMode + fncall/toolcall: normalize-on-resume + schema-aware stream parsing\" assigned to @albert. Priority: P2. https://tracker.redwood/infr/INF-6001

jonah: filing a tiny samplekit patch to default streaming to false for jsonMode fncall routes and adding the repro test to CI. will link INF-6001.

meera: i'll coordinate parity task between node/python SDK teams and add a short paragraph to onboarding docs describing the streaming+union caveat and the temporary samplekit toggle.

albert: action items I'll own: implement idempotent streaming normalizer in node SDK, spec it in the SDK-core doc so python matches, add resume-safe buffer preservation in the retry layer.

sophie: +1 on the contract lint. i can add it to samplekit CI (fail fast) so tool authors fix their outputs early.

jonah: thanks. leaving the small repro and logs in INF-6001. will PR hotfix to samplekit today to unblock ongoing PoCs. :raised_hands:
